title: Explore Freedom – A Gravel Bike Journey
content:
Rose Bikes brought together six strangers of varying cycling backgrounds and set them out on three different routes in pairs to all finish in the same location. Straight outta the Real World, the group learns to work with each other and accept their own limitations, while making for a very entertaining video. You’ll recognize a few of the faces here and Petor’s in this one, so expect some extra funny humor as well.

The post Explore Freedom – A Gravel Bike Journey appeared first on The Radavist.
author: John Watson
